name: Azolla Agronomy & Feed Guide
tag: Works out how much Azolla to grow for your animals and how to set up the ponds.

scenarios.title: Supplement dairy cows
scenarios.ask: I have {cows} cows. I want to feed {kg} of fresh Azolla per cow per day.
steps: Need
Daily need is {=round(cows * kg, 1)} kg of fresh Azolla.
Yield model
At about {=yield} kg per square meter per day, you need {=round(cows * kg / yield)} square meters of pond.
Layout
Planned {=ceil(cows * kg / yield / 4)} pits of 2 m x 2 m, lined, 10 to 15 cm deep.
Nutrition
Fresh Azolla is mostly water. Dry matter is about 6%, with roughly a quarter of that as protein.
followups: No. It is a supplement. Most guides introduce it slowly, mixed with regular feed, and the guide keeps it as a share of the ration.
Is Azolla allowed where I live?
Some Azolla species are invasive in some regions. Check local rules before you buy a starter culture or let ponds overflow.
Sample setup cost is about ${=ceil(cows * kg / yield / 4) * 40} for liners, shade net and starter, using local prices you can edit.

scenarios.title: Feed a poultry flock
scenarios.ask: I keep {birds} chickens and want to give each {grams} of fresh Azolla a day.
steps: Need
Daily need is {=round(birds * grams / 1000, 1)} kg of fresh Azolla.
Pond sizing
At 0.25 kg per square meter per day, that is {=round(birds * grams / 1000 / 0.25)} square meters.
Harvest plan
Harvest about a third of the cover daily so it keeps growing.
Feeding tip
Rinse and drain before feeding, and mix with regular feed.
followups: Some trials report benefits, but results vary. Track your own flock in the app before changing the ration further.
Growth slows in cold weather. The guide shows a smaller winter harvest so you can plan backup feed.

scenarios.title: Start your first ponds
scenarios.ask: I want to cover {area} of pond. My climate is {climate}. How much starter do I need and when can I harvest?
steps: Starter
Seed at about 0.5 kg per square meter: {=round(area * 0.5, 1)} kg of starter culture.
Water
Fill to 12 cm: about {=round(area * 120)} liters, with a thin layer of soil and manure slurry.
Timeline
In a {climate} climate, expect full cover and first harvest in about {=climate} days.
Sourcing
Listed what to ask a supplier: species, how it was grown, and whether it is free of snails and algae.
followups: Why did my Azolla turn red?
Usually too much sun or too little phosphorus. Add shade net and a small dose of fertilizer, then check again in a week.
Yes. Start one pit and expand as it grows. It takes longer but costs less.
